Information disclosed in accordance with Listing Rule 11.2.6 (former LR 15.4)

In accordance with Listing Rule 11.2.6 (former LR 15.4) the Company confirms that, as at the close of business on 30th September 2026, it had one portfolio investment in 3i Group plc being a company which itself does not have a stated investment policy that limits its investments in other listed closed-ended investment funds to no more than 15% of its total assets.
